local_certificate.transition: exact boundary map q:B->B' followed by existential projection inside q-fibres
local_certificate.certificate: (b0,b1,w) with b0!=b1, q(b0)=q(b1), and R(b0,w) != R(b1,w)
local_certificate.verification: evaluate q and the frozen Boolean/RREF representation on two boundary assignments and one witness assignment
local_certificate.cost: polynomial in representation size plus assignment length
local_certificate.meaning: two semantically distinct old continuation states are genuinely identified by the transition
local_certificate.negative_control: no such certificate exists for a bijective re-encoding q
local_certificate.claim_ceiling: this certifies one genuine semantic collision only; it does not prove global monotone progress or polynomial terminalization

continuation_count_killer.theorem: existential projection OR-combines residual relations inside fibres, so the number of distinct residual continuation relations can increase under a genuine many-to-one projection

result.main_lesson: Irreversibility certification and termination progress are different obligations. A small collision witness can prove that a transition is not a reversible alias, but continuation-class count is not a monotone and therefore cannot by itself drive a polynomial descent to TRUE/FALSE.

kills: continuation-equivalence-class count N_R as a universal monotone
mu=ceil(log2 N_R) as a universal monotone
the inference genuine collision => strictly smaller continuation-class complexity
survives: polynomial local certificates of genuine noninjective semantic merging
a future termination argument with a separate complexity/debt measure
